tools.name: list_test_faxes
tools.description: List the test faxes that Faxbeep received and published, newest first. The list is public and holds the tests of everyone. Each item of "faxes" is a fax object: slug, source ("phone" or "email"), from (the sender, masked as on faxbeep.com, or null), received_at, page_count, file_size, pdf_url, thumb

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_test_numbers, list_test_faxes, get_test_fax · Private data: get_test_numbers, get_test_fax · Public sink: get_test_numbers, list_test_faxes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_test_numbers, list_test_faxes, get_test_fax · Private data: get_test_numbers, get_test_fax · Public sink: get_test_numbers, list_test_faxes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
